title: Relative nerve of a chain of symmetric operads is a family
statement: Use symmetric infinity-operads, inert maps, families and their inert edges as in [def-coef-symmetric-operadic-family], and the explicit relative nerve $R_{[m]}(D)$ of [lem-cbc-strict-presentation-transport-representation]. Let $D:[m]\to\mathsf{sSet}_{/N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)}$ be a strict diagram of small symmetric infinity-operads whose transition maps preserve inert edges and whose maps to $N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)$ commute strictly. The subset-indexed relative-nerve formula defines a family $(b,t):R_{[m]}(D)\to N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)\times\Delta^m$ with vertex fibres exactly $D(i)$; its inert edges are precisely the inert cocartesian edges in the vertex operads. For $x\in D(a)$ and $y\in D(b)$ with $a\le b$, its mapping spaces satisfy natural equivalences $\operatorname{Map}(x,y)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{D(b)}(D(a\to b)x,y)$ over the pointed-map base, while for $a>b$ they are empty. Every order map $\beta:[l]\to[m]$ identifies the pullback with $R_{[l]}(D\beta)$ over both bases. These assertions include repeated vertices, $m=0$, zero arity, and empty fibres.
